content.title: Trump to address nation at 9 p.m. ET. What is it about? How to watch
content.text: April 1, 2026, 3:39 p.m. ETPresident Donald Trump is set to address the nation Wednesday night, providing an update on the Iran War.The announcement comes as Trump faces increasing criticism about the war and a dropping approval rating.White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt announced Tuesday night that the president would provide an important update on Iran shortly after Trump himself shared a two-or-three week timeline for the end of the war.When asked about how much longer the war would last, Trump told reporters in the Oval Office, "I think within two or three weeks, we’ll leave. There’s no reason for us to do this."In the meantime, political opponents are pointing out this war contradicts one of Trump's talking points that he's a messenger of peace. Sen. Elizabeth Warren, D-Mass, took to X before the address to point out that Trump allies who said he wouldn't start wars are liars.The war has raged since Feb. 28th and continues to escalate amid reports that aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush was deployed Tuesday, set to go to the Middle East along with three destroyers and a group of over 6,000 sailors. Thousands of soldiers from the 82nd Airborne Division have also begun arriving, and there are reports of at least 2500 marines that recently entered the region aboard the USS Tripoli.Iran rejected a 15-point peace plan offered by U.S. officials March 25.As of Wednesday morning, Trump claims Iran asked for a ceasefire on his Truth Social "Iran’s New Regime President, much less Radicalized and far more intelligent than his predecessors, has just asked the United States of America for a CEASEFIRE! We will consider when Hormuz Strait is open, free, and clear. Until then, we are blasting Iran into oblivion or, as they say, back to the Stone Ages."However, according to officials, Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson dismissed Trump's statement about Iran requesting a ceasefire calling it "false and baseless."Thirteen US service members have been confirmed killed in the Iran war thus far.Here's what to know, when and how to watch Trump's primetime address tonight.What time is Trump address to the nation tonight? When to watchPresident Donald Trump is expected to address the nation during primetime on Wednesday, April 1 at 9 p.m. ET., in a speech that Leavitt noted was to "provide an important update on Iran."How to watch Trump's address to the nation tonight? Where to streamTrump's address to the nation will be broadcast on all major television networks, including ABC, NBC, CBS, CNN, Fox News and NewsNation at 9 p.m. ET on Wednesday, April 1.The address can also be live streamed via USA TODAY or via The White House's website and YouTube channel.
